name: How do I choose a contractor for an accessibility bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for an accessibility bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for an accessibility bathroom remodel, look for experience in accessible design and construction, good communication skills, and a strong portfolio of similar projects. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references or reviews. A contractor who understands your specific needs and local building codes is essential for a successful outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, strong communication, proper licensing, and good references.
